words.definition: A sign that shows you may be ill.
words.example: Fever is a common symptom of flu.
words.example_id: Demam adalah gejala flu yang umum.

words.definition: To become healthy again after illness.

words.example_id: Dia pulih dengan cepat setelah operasi.

words.example_id: Saya membuat janji temu dengan dokter gigi.

words.definition: Protected against a disease.
words.example: Vaccines help the body become immune.

words.example_id: Dia mengalami cedera lutut saat berlari.

words.definition: Containing substances that keep you healthy.
words.example: Vegetables are cheap and nutritious.

words.definition: A shop where medicines are sold.

words.definition: A feeling of being extremely tired.

words.definition: To take air into your lungs and let it out.

words.definition: A medicine that kills bacteria.

words.definition: A strip of cloth used to cover a wound.
words.example: The nurse changed the bandage.

words.definition: To push air out of your throat noisily.

words.definition: The food you usually eat.

words.definition: To supply your body with water.

words.definition: Something you take to treat an illness.

words.definition: A person trained to care for sick people.
words.example: The nurse checked my blood pressure.

words.definition: A person receiving medical care.
words.example: The patient is recovering well.

words.definition: A small place where you see a doctor.

words.definition: A dark mark on the skin after a knock.

words.definition: A routine medical examination.

words.definition: A measured amount of medicine.

words.definition: In good physical condition.
words.example: Walking daily keeps you healthy.

words.definition: Medicine put into the body with a needle.

words.definition: How healthy your mind and emotions are.
words.example: Sleep affects your mental health.
